title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Hormuz headline risk flipped the tape. Oil +3.47% on Saudi tanker attacks sank the Dow 180 points, but semis +0.34% capped losses. Earnings misses (HON -21%, WDC -13%, APP -20%) drove dispersion while breadth stayed narrow.

INDICES — VIX 15.2, below 20-day MA 17.2. SOXX +0.34%, SPY -0.16%, QQQ -0.37%, IWM -0.51%, DIA -0.85%. Small > large by 0.35pp. Oil +3.47% was the cross-asset mover; 10Y yield 4.67%. SPY above 200-day, QQQ below — CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME — SPY vol 0.9x average, QQQ 0.8x — both light, confirming low-conviction drift on index drag. GLD 1.7x on flat price suggests accumulation bid under the surface. XLK at 0.8x with price down = quiet distribution in tech.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE +1.48%, XLC +0.28%, XLV +0.18%, XLP -0.26%, XLK -0.31%, XLF -0.33%, XLY -0.46%, XLU -0.64%, XLI -0.85%, XLRE -0.86%, XLB -0.89%. Top: MSOS +7.67%, USO +3.47%. Bottom: WGMI -3.52%, DRAM -4.28%. Energy money-in on Hormuz risk; semis and homebuilders out. Rotation label: broad risk-on, energy-led defensive bid.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.25 elevated = protection demand; QQQ PCR 0.97 neutral. IV skews positive (SPY +4.0%, QQQ +7.2%) = put premium intact. QQQ GEX flip 728 vs spot ~703 — price below flip, dealer hedging amplifies downside. MOVE 76.1 above MA 70 = bond vol stress.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +3.47% vs JETS -2.65% — classic supply-shock transmission into airlines. Dollar +0.36% while gold flat — oil-driven inflation bid overrode traditional USD-gold inverse.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed 65.8/100. Movers: PH +7.31% (2.5x vol, accumulation ahead of GDP data), ALB +5.54% (2.0x vol, earnings beat), UPS -4.18%. 20d momentum best: XLE +6.09%; worst: XLU -3.88%. Watch: HON — 20%+ collapse on guidance cut, vol spike pending; SOXX — 5d +5.55% vs 20d -8.45%, momentum divergence; QQQ — 1.19% above gamma flip, dealer hedging zone.
